title: HyperX ChargePlay Quad 2 Joy-Con Charging Station, New

comparisons.notes: Exact match: SKU 6Y2G7AA, ChargePlay Quad 2, white/red, page says Availability: In stock, checked 2026-11-05T01:15:00-05:00

writeup: Woot has the HyperX ChargePlay Quad 2 Joy-Con charging station new for $16.99. It charges four original Switch or OLED Joy-Cons in about 3.5 hours and matches HyperX MPN 6Y2G7AA in white/red. HyperX's own store sells the same dock for $29.99 in stock, so this is $13 under street price. Limit 3 per order; does not work with Switch 2 Joy-Cons.
